name_en: Peony barrage — ten bursts open at frame one, never fewer than eight on screen

prompt_en: A massive fireworks barrage against pure black, the grand finale of a victory celebration, at maximum density from the very first frame. The first frame already has ten or more large bursts open and expanding at the same time, spread edge to edge and corner to corner, and from there new bursts keep opening at a rate of three or four every second, so the number of fireworks on screen at once never drops below eight and the black is never left bare for even a moment. No empty lead-in, no single rocket rising first, no build-up, no pauses between salvos. Each burst is a wide, perfectly round sphere of hundreds of separate sparks flying outward in every direction, each spark a small sharp point of white-hot light dragging one thin bright trail behind it, and the bursts come at every size and every height, big ones overlapping small ones, so their spheres cross and interleave all over the frame. The spheres expand fast, the sparks slow and arc over, their trails thin out and break into flickering fragments that twinkle and go out, while three more bursts are already opening over them. The whole frame stays crowded with thousands of sparks travelling in all directions at once. Only in the last moment of the clip do the final sparks fade and the frame go completely black. The sparks are white-hot at the core and fall through warm gold, and every burst is a sphere of distinct points and trails rather than a soft glowing cloud. The background is pure flat black, completely empty and perfectly still: no smoke, no haze, no mist, no fog, no atmospheric glow, no ground, no horizon, no city, no buildings, no trees, no water, no reflections, no crowd, no silhouettes, no stars, no clouds, no moon. Nothing in the frame is lit except the fireworks themselves. Locked-off static camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no push in, no pan, no tilt, no orbit, no shake, no parallax, no cuts, no scene change. No lens flare, no bloom washing over the whole frame, no vignette, no depth of field, no film grain, no motion blur smear. Every burst opens fully inside the frame and is never cropped by the edges. Clean high-contrast game VFX plate, bright light on black, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no letterboxing.
prompt_zh: 纯黑背景下的一场大规模烟花齐射，庆祝胜利的压轴终场，从第一帧起就是最大密度。第一帧上就已经有十余发大型烟花同时炸开并向外扩张，铺满整个画面、从边缘到边缘、从这个角落到那个角落；此后每秒都有三到四发新的绽放打开，屏幕上同时绽放的数量始终不少于八发，黑色背景一刻也不会空出来。没有空镜头的铺垫，没有先升起单独一枚的过程，没有酝酿，齐射之间没有停顿。每一发都是一个宽阔而浑圆的球体，数百颗彼此分离的火星朝四面八方向外飞散，每一颗都是细小锐利的白热光点，身后拖着一条细亮的尾迹；绽放大小不一、高度不一，大的与小的彼此重叠，球体在整个画面上交错穿插。球体迅速扩张，火星减速并划弧下坠，尾迹变细、碎成闪烁的碎屑并熄灭，而此时又有三发新的在它们上方打开。整个画面始终挤满成千上万颗朝各个方向飞散的火星。只有在影片的最后一瞬，残余的火星才淡去，画面才变成全黑。火星核心是白热的，下坠时转为暖金色；每一发都是由清晰分明的光点和尾迹构成的球体，而不是柔软的发光云团。背景是纯正的全黑，完全空旷、绝对静止：没有烟雾、没有雾气、没有薄雾、没有霭、没有大气辉光，没有地面、没有地平线、没有城市、没有建筑、没有树木、没有水面、没有倒影，没有人群、没有剪影，没有星星、没有云、没有月亮。画面中除了烟花本身，没有任何被照亮的东西。固定机位，镜头完全锁定，无镜头运动、无变焦、无推近、无横摇、无俯仰、无环绕、无抖动、无视差，无剪辑、无场景切换。无镜头光晕，无覆盖整个画面的泛光，无暗角，无景深虚化，无胶片颗粒，无运动模糊拖影。每一次绽放都完整地在画面内展开，绝不被画面边缘裁切。干净的高对比游戏特效素材，黑底亮光，无文字、无数字、无水印、无标志、无黑边。
